findings.current: Behind Jin Taekyung, Wu Heixing had been gathering the handful of Red Guard Gang Hunters who remained. He grabbed one of the Western Front suicide-squad members and asked,
findings.defect: “Who remained” adds the implication that these Hunters are survivors of an earlier loss or attrition. The Korean only says that Wu Heixing was gathering a group numbering no more than a handful.
findings.rationale: 한 줌밖에 안 되는 describes the small number of the Hunters, not that they are those left over from a previous group.
findings.replacement: Behind Jin Taekyung, Wu Heixing was gathering the handful of Red Guard Gang Hunters. He grabbed one of the Western Front suicide-squad members and asked,

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with two minor fidelity defects: an unsupported implication that the Red Guard Gang Hunters are survivors, and a duplicated speechlessness beat that interrupts the source's action transition.
